note: PDF Reader ships one field formatter, FieldPdfReaderFields (label 'PDF Reader'), for field types string, file, and uri. It is configured per field on Manage display; its settings (pdf_width, pdf_height, renderer, embed_view_fit, embed_hide_toolbar, download, link_placement) are stored as ordinary formatter settings on the entity_view_display component. Renderers: google, ms, embed, pdf-js, and colorbox (only with Colorbox + Libraries). Easy cases are grounded in the real plugin id, renderers, field types, and settings. Medium/hard cases create a string field on Article and set/read the PDF Reader formatter on the view display. SMOKE-TEST STATUS: the medium/hard scripts create field storage, which was NOT possible on the shared eval site at authoring time because a pre-existing broken commerce_giftcard entity state makes every route rebuild (triggered by field-storage creation) fatal; consequently the medium/hard cases here were NOT smoke-tested. The scripts follow the proven field-creation + view-display pattern and are expected to pass once field-storage creation works again. Easy cases require no site changes.

evals.prompt: In the Drupal pdf_reader module, what is the field formatter's plugin id, and which field types can it be applied to?
evals.expected_output: The formatter plugin id is FieldPdfReaderFields (label 'PDF Reader'), applicable to field types string, file, and uri.

evals.prompt: Which PDF renderers does the pdf_reader formatter offer, and which one needs an extra module?
evals.expected_output: The 'renderer' setting offers google (Google Docs Viewer), ms (Microsoft Office viewer), embed (direct embed), and pdf-js (bundled pdf.js). The colorbox renderer appears only when the Colorbox and Libraries modules are enabled.

evals.prompt: What settings does the pdf_reader (PDF Reader) field formatter expose, and what are the default width/height and renderer?
evals.expected_output: Settings: pdf_width (default 600), pdf_height (default 780), renderer (default google), embed_view_fit (Fit/FitH/FitV, direct-embed only), embed_hide_toolbar, download, link_placement (top/bottom).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a field (field_pdf_known) configured to display through PDF Reader. Inspect the live Article default view display and state which renderer that field's PDF Reader formatter uses.
evals.expected_output: field_pdf_known uses the FieldPdfReaderFields formatter with renderer = pdf-js in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default.

evals.prompt: The Article content type on this site has a field named field_pdf_render displayed with PDF Reader. Inspect the live view-display configuration and state which renderer it uses and whether a download link is enabled.
evals.expected_output: field_pdf_render uses FieldPdfReaderFields with renderer = embed (direct embed), embed_view_fit = FitH, embed_hide_toolbar = true, and download = true (link_placement = bottom).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a plain-text field field_pdf_task that holds a PDF URL. Configure the Article default view display so this field renders with the pdf_reader module's PDF Reader formatter. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_pdf_task component uses type FieldPdfReaderFields (PDF Reader formatter).

evals.prompt: My Article pages have a field (field_pdf_doc) with a link to a PDF document, but it just shows the URL as text. I want the PDF itself to appear embedded on the page. Make that happen using the PDF Reader module.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_pdf_doc component uses type FieldPdfReaderFields (PDF Reader formatter).
